planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Admin/Inventory and read the stock quantity shown for the first product in the list. Remember this number.
Navigate to /Admin/PurchaseOrders and click the control to raise a new purchase order
Choose the first vendor in the vendor dropdown
Add one order line: pick the same product whose quantity was noted, and set the quantity to 5
Submit the form to create the purchase order
Assert the purchase order was created and a purchase order number is shown. If the form is still displayed with validation errors, this test must fail.
Open the newly created purchase order and click the control to mark it as received
Assert the purchase order status now reads as received
Assert the stock quantity for that product is now exactly five more than the number noted at the start. If it is unchanged, this test must fail.
